description: Redaction vectors for redact.ts (redact_test.ts). Each redact case runs through redactPIIAsOf(input, ref_year) and must equal output; output must also be a fixed point (idempotence). asks_for_sensitive lists assistant lines and whether the next user turn is masked.

six oh two double five five oh one nine nine
